## CornBoard Data
```{r}
cornboard$Pen <- as.character(cornboard$Pen)
cornboard$Block <- as.factor(cornboard$Block)
cornboard$Rep <- as.character(cornboard$Rep)
cornboard$TRT <- as.factor(cornboard$TRT)
summary(cornboard)
```

## PCA on Cornboard Data Set
```{r}
mat <- as.matrix(cbind(cornboard$Initial,cornboard$HCW,cornboard$CAFBW,cornboard$ADG,cornboard$DMI,cornboard$`G:F`,cornboard$`F:G`,cornboard$REA,cornboard$`Yield Grade`,cornboard$Fat,cornboard$Marbling)) 
names <- c("Initial","HCW","CAFBW","ADG","DMI","`G:F`","`F:G`","REA","`Yield Grade`","Fat","Marbling") 
colnames(mat)=names 
i = diag(c(rep(1,40)))

## compute correlation matrix
one <- matrix(c(rep(1,40)))
m <- (i - one%*%(solve(t(one)%*%one))%*%t(one)) 
cov = t(mat)%*%m%*%mat / 39
d <- sqrt(solve(diag(diag(cov)))); 
corr <- d%*%cov%*%d 
colnames(corr)=names
rownames(corr)=names 
corr
```
## Eigen Value and Eigen Vectors
```{r}
 ecorr <- eigen(corr)         
 ## pca on correlation matrix 
pctexpcor = 100*(ecorr$values/11) 
lcor <- sqrt(ecorr$values);  
ecor <- ecorr$vectors
rownames(ecor)=names     
rrcor <- t(lcor*t(ecor))       
ecorr$values
pctexpcor
ecor
t_var = 5.5375006072 + 2.8692623645 + 0.9150094947 + 0.6516347744 + 0.5724888496 + 0.3239052529 + 0.0936985697 + 0.0322793851 + 0.0028176774 + 0.0010384931 + 0.0003645313
t3 = 5.5375006072 + 2.8692623645 + 0.9150094947
t_perc = t3/t_var
pc1_3 <- ecor[, 1:3]  
pc1_3
```



## Selecting The needed variables for EDA
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
## Subsetting the Corn board data set
cornboard_sub <- cornboard[, c("Pen","Block" , "Rep", "TRT","ADG", "DMI","F:G")]

# Extract percentage and treatment
cornboard_sub <- cornboard_sub %>%
  mutate(TRT = gsub("%", "", TRT)) %>%  # Remove "%" symbol
  separate(TRT, into = c("Percentage", "Treatment"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") %>%
  mutate(Percentage = as.numeric(Percentage))  # Convert percentage to numeric

# Replace NA in 'Value' with 0
cornboard_sub$Percentage[is.na(cornboard_sub$Percentage)] <- 0

# Replace NA in 'Treatment' with "control"
cornboard_sub$Treatment[is.na(cornboard_sub$Treatment)] <- "control"
```


## Exploratory Data Analysis
```{r}
# Distribution of the Responses
hist(cornboard_sub$ADG)
hist(cornboard_sub$DMI)
hist(cornboard_sub$`F:G`)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
#Bloxplot for the treatment combinations
# Create boxplot with different colors for blocks
ggplot(cornboard_sub, aes(x = interaction(Percentage, Treatment), y = ADG, fill = Block)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Boxplot for ADG",
       x = "Treatment Combination",
       y = "ADG") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")

ggplot(cornboard_sub, aes(x = interaction(Percentage, Treatment), y = DMI, fill = Block)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Boxplot for DMI",
       x = "Treatment Combination",
       y = "DMI") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")


ggplot(cornboard_sub, aes(x = interaction(Percentage, Treatment), y = `F:G`, fill = Block)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Boxplot for F:G",
       x = "Treatment Combination",
       y = "F:G") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3")

```


### Model
```{r}
# Creating a new column Control (y or n)
# Yes if treatment is a control and No otherwise
cornboard_sub$Control <- ifelse(cornboard_sub$Treatment == "control", "y", "n")
# Write to CSV file
write.csv(cornboard_sub, "cornboard_sub.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


## Factorial Plus Control

```{r}
drug_table <- data.frame(
  `Drug Type` = c("Soluble", "Soluble", "Non-soluble", "Non-soluble", "No Drug"),
  Dosage = c(10, 15, 10, 15, 0),
  Description = c("Treatment A1B1", "Treatment A1B2", "Treatment A2B1", "Treatment A2B2", "Control"),
  `Replicates per Clinic (Block)` = c(
    "1 per clinic × 3 clinics = 3",
    "3",
    "3",
    "3",
    "3 (1 in each clinic)"
  ),
  check.names = FALSE  # To allow special characters in column names
)

# Print the table
print(drug_table, row.names = FALSE)



anova_df <- data.frame(
  Source = c(
    "Block (Clinic)",
    "Drug Type",
    "Dosage",
    "Drug Type × Dosage",
    "Control",
    "Error",
    "Total"
  ),
  `Degrees of Freedom (DF)` = c(
    "3 – 1 = 2",
    "2 – 1 = 1",
    "2 – 1 = 1",
    "(2 – 1)(2 – 1) = 1",
    "1",
    "15 – (2 + 4) = 9",
    "15 – 1 = 14"
  ),
  check.names = FALSE  # Allows special characters in column names
)

# Print the table
print(anova_df, row.names = FALSE)
```
